purpose: Complete an authored, state-aware continuous DNA path under the unique C vehicle controller, without changing accepted catalog timbres.

runtime.source: Pure parameter synthesis only; no waveform assets, playback or spatial processing.
runtime.clock: One main harmonic phase/root clock and one driver. State banks supply interpolated magnitudes, statistical variation and relative L/R phases.
runtime.transition: Explicit configurable first-order weight smoothing; state assignment comes from the existing lifecycle/operating enum.
runtime.alignment: Non-RT arbitrary cycle-origin alignment and relative phase offsets; never claim physical cylinder timing.
runtime.missing_states: Fall back to base DNA; report the available mask and actual/target weights.
runtime.scope: New authored DNA only; catalog LF/resonance/idle assets are not inherited or silently combined.
runtime.resources: No optimization or ADI porting; all donor statistical states continue on the common clock for predictable transitions.

host.package: Explicit DNA schema2 carries base anchors, optional idle/power/overrun anchors and transition_seconds; schema1 remains supported.
host.window: Extend stopped-only DNA editor with state selection, optional imports and transition time; expose actual state blend in independent controller.
host.persistence: Existing DNA field carries the complete new parameter package through engine, recipe, take, scenario, replay and stem export; bind every coefficient to source identity.
host.build: New source ABI9/build directory; retain original V8 binary and old documents with original binary.

verification: Known single harmonic/phase and positive-magnitude morph cases, relative stereo phase, weights, invalid C configs and ownership.
Actual preserved V8 vs V9 catalog presets, default authored DNA, events, startup abort and lifecycle PCM/state/notices exact.
State changes at fixed RPM alter sound, fallback and endpoints work, common phase never resets, no unrelated optional layer leaks.
Actual parameter package import/export, full 32-second native lifecycle, variable-block replay, all dry stems and event identity.
Actual owned bounded muted native window, state editor, recipe/take restoration and saved-take replay; close all owned processes.
Freeze exact sources and evidence; report quality/calibration gaps separately from engineering checks.
constraints: No subagents, commits, push, persistent app restart or new unapproved media download.
Do not resume old inverse-solver research or claim new timbre acceptance.
Existing startup hearing and G1/G2/G3 approval requests remain pending.
